description: Cross-kernel B-rep validity, tolerance and persistent naming need independent conformance.
AP242 exchange does not prove complete native feature-history preservation.
Recurrence results across timezone database editions need executable oracles.
Every proposed relation remains open until manual law comparison and two independent implementations.
CityGML conceptual model to GML/JSON/database encodings lacks complete loss matrices.
Genomic finding, interpretation, diagnosis and recommendation authority remain distinct and unbound.
CMS/COSE translation and verification require dated algorithm/key-purpose policy.
Private tags, burned-in PHI and de-identification profiles require fixture-based qualification.
FIX dictionaries, custom tags, session profiles and venue dialects require occurrence qualification.
Assembly, sequence, transcript and ontology edition resolution needs a governed registry.
IFC schema validity must not substitute for model-view and project information requirements.
Message schema must be paired with jurisdiction/network market-practice constraints.
Caption completeness, reading order and accessibility are authoritative review claims, not parse results.
Venue-specific sequencing, recovery and priority rules need exact profiles and replay corpora.
Crosswalk preservation claims lack executable positive/negative/boundary/lossy fixtures.
HDF5/netCDF/FITS carrier conformance does not cover discipline conventions.
Provider mailbox exports and retry/dedup identities are not qualified.
FFT normalization, PSD conventions, windows and unit conversions need formal profiles.
The open extension universe needs governed occurrence/version records.
VCF/VRS/liftover equivalence requires executable reference-aware law oracles.
